title: Fingerprint code and context candidates
objective: Fingerprint code and context candidates. Implement only this observable slice using the frozen schema and port contracts.

acceptance_criteria.description: Deterministically hash exact base/head, diff, graph, context, validation, policy and checklist inputs
acceptance_criteria.verification: TASK-019 owned behavior tests and structured handoff evidence

acceptance_criteria.description: Invalidate candidates for each material code/context input change without self-referential hashes
acceptance_criteria.verification: TASK-019 failure-case tests and structured handoff evidence

output_contracts: reviews/candidates public behavior described by this task acceptance; use predeclared ports
size_rationale: One component outcome with two bounded acceptance checks; no central registry edits. Split further through isolation review if implementation exceeds this estimate.
out_of_scope: Changing shared contracts without a new prerequisite task
Production provider integration, paid services, remote publication and product-scope changes
handoff_requirements: Exact base/commit and verified changed paths
Actual test command evidence and acceptance mapping
Public interface/dependency notes, deviations and risks
resume_state: Manual coordinator dispatched an isolated implementation; acceptance requires both fresh independent reviews.
